text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur—an Umamusume governed by logic. Although she seems annoyed after her conversation with Fine Motion, she still seems curious about her data.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is convinced that Fine Motion is clearly different from other Umamusume… and that she might have what it takes to change Shakur's own fate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She then tells me something quite intriguing. "Keep an eye on her. Your job is to keep her running right up to the very end."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what exactly she sees in Fine Motion, but I take Air Shakur's words to heart.
